descriptions.inProgress: I talked to Claudia, she needs #b25 Squishy Liquids#k for her new hair gel. She's offered to give me a free EXP Hair Salon coupon in return. She seems like a nice enough gal...
descriptions.completed: I got the Squishy Liquids for Claudia and she gave me an EXP Hair Salon coupon for her shop. I can use it once to get my hair done for free!
